requirement:
The Python repository you were given has a bug. Fix it in place so the behaviour described in SPEC holds. Keep every public function and its signature, keep the existing tests passing, and add a regression test that would have caught the bug.

SYMPTOM: `word_count('Hi, hi! HI?')` returns {'hi,': 1, 'hi!': 1, 'hi?': 1} instead of {'hi': 3}.

SPEC: Count words case-insensitively; a word is a maximal run of letters, digits or apostrophes; punctuation separates words.

The code is in `lib/words.py`; read it from the repository (it is not repeated here).
